headline: Bond authorizations for Nashua Public Library renovation ($3,000,000), fire training facility ($1,500,000), and Pine Hill Fire Station replacement ($1,000,000).
summary: The agenda lists bond requests for capital equipment, a library renovation, fire facilities, and a city-wide enterprise resource planning system. It also includes a street acceptance, stop signs, parking garage leases, and parking permit changes.
items: Request from John Flatley Company's general counsel to purchase city-owned parcels
Mayor's veto of O-26-002 so it can be amended and passed
Public Works referral from Board of Aldermen (R-26-062)
Public comment on items expected to be acted on this evening
Communications requiring final approval
Petition for street acceptance: Juliana Avenue
Nominations, appointments and elections
Confirmation of mayor's appointments
R-26-064, Amended: bonds not to exceed $5,173,428 for purchase of capital equipment
R-26-067: bonds not to exceed $3,000,000 for design and ancillary costs to renovate the Nashua Public Library
R-26-068: bonds not to exceed $1,500,000 for design, construction and equipping of a fire training facility
R-26-069: bonds not to exceed $1,000,000 for design and ancillary costs to replace the Pine Hill Fire Station
R-26-070: bonds not to exceed $1,000,000 for deferred capital maintenance of fire stations
R-26-071: bonds not to exceed $9,000,000 for replacement and modernization of the city-wide enterprise resource planning (ERP) system

R-26-075: second amended federal aid project agreement with the State of New Hampshire and the Town of Hudson to rehabilitate the Taylor Falls and Veterans bridges, and accept an additional $231,941.29
R-26-076: accept $45,180 from the United States Department of Justice into the 2025 Justice Assistance Grant (Multi-Jurisdictional) police grant activity
O-26-024: additional stop signs to make an all way stop at French Street and Abbott Street
O-26-002: allowing electronic public comment for people with walking disabilities (mayor vetoed on 10/20/26)
R-26-015: supporting the Town of Merrimack in its opposition to an ICE detention center (tabled 2/24/26)
R-26-020: bonds not to exceed $900,000 for a resource center at 14 Mulberry Street (tabled 4/22/26)
R-26-077: supplemental appropriation of $146,617.94 of FY2027 unanticipated revenue into Fund #7024 Opioid Abatement Expendable Trust Fund
R-26-078: first amendment to High Street Garage lease with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC
R-26-079: School Street Parking Garage lease with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC
O-26-027: amendment to parking permits for High Street Garage
O-26-028: amendment to parking permits for School Street Parking Garage
Period for general public comment
Remarks by members of the Board of Aldermen
Committee announcements
Non-public session
